title: Timed Reading and Academic Performance: Advantages of Sustained Reading Practice
prompt: In many universities, students are assessed through timed reading tasks that require matching information, completing gaps, and sustaining attention across long passages. Some educators argue that regular practice with such timed reading conditions gives students lasting advantages in their academic studies and beyond. To what extent do you agree that timed reading practice offers more advantages than disadvantages for university students? In your essay, state your position clearly, discuss the advantages and any disadvantages you consider significant, and give your own view supported by relevant examples from study or everyday life. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请按学术任务2要求作答：先明确表达你对“限时阅读练习利大于弊”的立场，再讨论其优势与可能的弊端，并用学习或生活中的例子支持观点。建议用约5分钟规划结构，确保每个主体段有清晰主题句，并在结论中重申立场。全文不少于250词，注意时间分配与长文耐力。
